description: This script is a database patch for ERPNext, specifically for setting up inter-state GST configurations in the Indian regional settings. It reloads various document types related to payroll, accounts, stock, and taxes, then updates 'is_inter_state' flags in tax templates based on GST account associations for Sales and Purchase taxes.

methods.name: execute()
methods.description: Main function to reload documents and update 'is_inter_state' flags in tax templates based on GST account configurations.

methods.name: get_formatted_data(doctype, igst_accounts, cgst_accounts)
methods.description: Helper function to generate conditional SQL 'when' clauses for updating tax templates, based on groupings of accounts related to GST configurations.
